## ParallaxLayer2D

`class` from [`src/addons/parallax/index.js`](../../../src/addons/parallax/index.js)

Repeating image layer drawn through an existing Screen. Owns only its offsets. Supply an image or assets service; shared bootstrap assets remain the default. The caller drives hooks and owns the screen, camera and image lifetime.
